verdict.rationale: Devin's cloud sessions run in dedicated VMs with shell/browser/full repo access, can implement features, run tests, and continue autonomously after handoff, then present PRs for review (docs-1,13,17). However, community hands-on reports describe unreliable autonomy — extraneous breaking changes, inability to self-correct, and needing frequent human monitoring/termination — undercutting the 'build, test, demo end-to-end' promise. missing for 10: reliable independent verification of unattended end-to-end demo quality, and clearer evidence of a built-in demo/walkthrough artifact for reviewers beyond PR creation.
